name: /sdd:plan: interrogates before planning, and targets the spec repo
prompt: /sdd:plan add rate limiting to the widgets endpoint

graders.why: the command is interactive by design; producing a plan without asking anything is the failure
planning artefacts land in the spec repo, never the main one
that path is forbidden as a target

graders.must_not_match: (?i)(I have written the plan|plan written to)
graders.why: it must gather requirements before writing

graders.must_not_match: (?i)(who are the stakeholders|what.{0,5}s the (estimated )?timeline|rollback strategy|priority level|expected complexity level)
graders.why: Part 1 used to carry a fixed question bank: stakeholders, timeline, priority, rollback, complexity. Every one of those has an answer for any project, which is why they were worthless, and five of them spend the question budget before reaching what this request actually left open. They came out; this stops them coming back in a rewrite
graders.violating_example: A few questions before I plan: who are the stakeholders, and what's the timeline?
